Which factor affecting the productivity of workers do you think is the most important? Explain

text: Study Sources 1 to 3.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
‘My business is successful because I take care of my workers.’
What are the strengths and weaknesses of the argument supporting this claim?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Workers are happier when they work in teams.’
How could you test this claim? You may consider the types of information, sources of evidence
or methods you might use.

text: Study Source 3.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify one opinion from Siya’s statement. Explain why this is an opinion.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Ruben is arguing that managers need to supervise workers to make them work hard.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Identify one fact from Ruben’s statement.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Explain how well this fact supports Ruben’s argument.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Which argument is more convincing, Ruben’s or Siya’s?
Your answer should consider both arguments and you should support your point of view with
their words.
You should also consider:
• the strength of their reasoning and evidence
• their use of language
• the different kinds of information used.

text: Study Source 4.
A large company wants to improve the productivity of its workers.
The following actions are being considered:
• pay the workers more money
• provide more training for workers
• encourage teamwork and collaboration.
Which one of these actions would you recommend to the company, and why?
In your answer, you should:
• state your recommendation
• give reasons and evidence to support your choice
• use the material in the sources and/or any of your own ideas
• consider different arguments and perspectives.
